title: Two Sum
statementMd:
Find the two positions whose values add up to the **target**, in one pass with a `HashMap` from value → index (O(n) instead of checking every pair). Exactly one answer exists. Print the two indices `i j` (0-based, i < j).

**Input**
Line 1: `n`. Line 2: n integers. Line 3: `target`.

**Output**
`i j`
hints: Walk the array once. For a[j], the partner you need is target - a[j].
Check the map BEFORE adding a[j], so an element is never paired with itself.
